title: 『ウグイス、ホトトギスにならず』

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky has invited Sakura Chiyono O to run in a scrimmage with her!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Determined not to lose to her role model, Sakura Chiyono O begins doing research on Maruzensky's races, but a few blunt words from Mr. C.B plant a seed of doubt in her heart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And once their race begins, that seed of doubt sprouts into a certainty—Maruzensky has never once felt desperation in a race… including theirs.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O then realizes that Maruzensky doesn't see her as a rival, which greatly upsets her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She swears to light a fire in Maruzensky's heart by taking on senior racers in the autumn Tenno Sho.
